releaseNotes:
- Large projects upload more assets in parallel and can reuse identical staged files after an interruption.
- Publishing identifies adopted recordings whose files are missing and lets you publish the affected lines as text.
- Upload errors distinguish a full temporary storage volume from an exhausted account quota.
releaseNotesZh:
- 发布大型作品时可并行上传更多素材，中断后可复用已暂存的相同文件。
- 发布时会提示已采用但文件缺失的配音，相应台词仍可按文字发布。
- 上传失败时会区分服务器临时空间不足与账户配额用尽。
